body.message:
If you wish to secure the unit for 7 months, you will need to pay the first month’s rent, last month’s rent, and the refundable security deposit in advance.

Please note that if you cancel the reservation during this period, the last month’s rent will be non-refundable, as the unit will have been blocked and held exclusively for you for the agreed period.

Alternatively, you may extend your stay on a monthly basis. However, please note that we cannot guarantee the unit’s availability for future months, as it is listed on multiple booking platforms and may receive a reservation at any time.
